primaryChecks.text: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.previousContext: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.nextContext: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
